title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. translated_title: 物理状态变化暴露了大语言模型中的公式误用问题
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在地球与环境科学领域的科学计算中应用日益广泛，但这些领域的问题往往涉及不同的物理状态（regimes）。LLMs可能无法识别这种依赖于物理状态的约束条件，在公式有效适用范围之外套用公式，从而产生看似合理但在物理上错误的结果。我们通过受控实验系统地研究了这类失败，并评估后训练能否提升模型对物理状态的感知推理能力。在72种物理机制上的实验表明，前沿LLMs经常在公式适用状态之外误用公式，导致准确率下降13-57个百分点。基于可验证奖励的强化学习使Qwen3.5-9B在依赖物理状态的任务上能够匹敌DeepSeek V4 Flash（284B），但其有效性受限于基础模型中已有的公式储备。将少量完整示例的监督微调与强化学习相结合……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过72种物理机制的受控实验揭示了大语言模型经常在公式有效范围之外误用公式（导致准确率下降13-57个百分点），并证明基于可验证奖励的强化学习结合监督微调能显著提升模型对物理状态的感知与推理能力。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments across 72 physical mechanisms, this paper reveals that frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity (reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points), and demonstrates that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, combined with supervised fine-tuning, substantially improves regime-aware reasoning.
